//: The 24/7 monitor roster for the hosted site. Edit this file to change what is watched; the scheduler reads it on every run. Same schema as statusdog.config.json. Thresholds assume checks run from the Seoul region (vercel.json `regions`) - moving that region invalidates them.

stats.//: 540 = KST, so a day boundary falls at midnight in Seoul rather than UTC.

defaults.//forbidBody: A half-broken page answers 200 with the bad news in the body. These strings only appear when something upstream has actually failed.

targets.name: CopyKiller
targets.//: Measured 175-225ms from Seoul, so maxResponseTimeMs is set well above that: it should catch real degradation, not the normal baseline. Pointed at www directly because the apex redirect took 17s from the old US region.
targets.//expectRedirects: www answers directly today. If an interstitial or locale redirect appears, that is a change worth knowing about.

targets.name: CopyKiller (apex redirect)
targets.//: Watches that copykiller.com still redirects to www and resolves. One hop, ending at www - both asserted, so a broken or retargeted redirect fails rather than passing quietly.

targets.name: StatusDog itself
targets.//expectHeaders: Our own endpoint, so we can hold it to its contract.
